svg.text: Compact: countdown only · Expanded: countdown → announcements → calendar · Sample data

g.text: PST for all paid ChatGPT accounts.
● Direct quota reset ◆ Reset credit ◇ Announced

svg.text: 01 Large digits show the remaining time, with a label below.
02 The expected date has its own label and row.
03 Reset type and quota note share the bottom row.
04 Compact and expanded modes share the same countdown card.
05 Keep 16 DIP between sections and 10 DIP below headings.
Countdown: 200 DIP. Announcements: 190 DIP, with internal scrolling.
Dates follow the system time zone; zone details appear in tooltips.
After the target time, show the last announced time without confirming personal quota.
All sizes use DIP and follow Windows scaling. Dates and posts are layout examples.
